name: rules-rtdb-r24-deny-without-rule
description: RTDB rules production verdicts for corpus scenario "r24-deny-without-rule" (rtdb#71). Captured by deploy-observe-restore (RTDB has no server-side rules test API). a request no .read or .write rule grants is denied even where the deepest rules node on the path has only children, only a .validate, or only the other operation's rule, so the simulator must deny it rather than report that it found no rule.
